bullets.text: In Gummidipoondi, traders staged a road protest after authorities demolished encroached shops along the GNT Road.
In Thiruvallur, two unidentified bike-borne individuals snatched a nine-sovereign gold thaali chain from a woman near the TVK district secretary office.
In Ambattur, police arrested seventeen ITI students who were roaming around the railway station with knives due to a social media feud.
In Chennai, Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay is scheduled to share the stage with Prime Minister Narendra Modi on October 11 for their first joint public appearance.
In Chennai, the Greater Chennai Corporation is implementing a major infrastructure upgrade and ICCC 2.0 to tackle urban flooding and modernize civic management.
In Chennai, drinking water reservoir storage levels have dropped to 37.9 percent of their total capacity amid El Nino conditions.
In South Chennai, a forty-day Kuppai Pirippom campaign successfully boosted household waste segregation, according to Greater Chennai Corporation officials.
In Thiruttani, a sudden fire broke out at the lamp-lighting area on the temple corridor, drawing numerous daily devotees.
In Avadi Commissionerate, police conducted a special three-day drive targeting history-sheeted offenders and individuals disrupting public peace.
In Chennai, the Metropolitan Transport Corporation issued tenders to install high-voltage sub-stations at Avadi, Perambur and KK Nagar depots for electric buses.
In Tamil Nadu, the iTNT Hub under the IT department has launched an AI-Focused Pre-Incubation Program to support artificial intelligence innovators.
In Coimbatore, TIDCO has invited bids for a techno-economic feasibility study to establish a four hundred crore rupee fintech hub.
In Chennai, an IIT Madras study revealed that educated professionals are also falling victim to digital financial scams due to various psychological factors.
In Coimbatore, actor Jai expressed confidence in the TVK administration and predicted a victory in the Tharanthapuram by-election.
In Chennai, the metro rail phase two operations from Poonamallee to Vadapalani will launch on October 11 with a ticket fare of forty rupees.
